description: This Java enum defines different types of interest posting periods for savings accounts in the Fineract microfinance platform. It includes constants like DAILY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, BIANNUAL, and ANNUAL, with associated integer values and string codes, as well as methods for retrieving enum instances from integers.

classes.name: SavingsPostingInterestPeriodType
classes.description: An enumeration representing different interest posting frequency types for savings accounts.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the interest period type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the interest period type.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values representing valid interest posting periods, excluding INVALID.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Returns the corresponding enum value for a given integer, defaulting to INVALID if the input does not match a known value.

search-terms: Java enum for savings interest periods
